svg.title: Nachtlorn — reconstructed sideways strips, provisional I-zero guide
svg.desc: Each original transcript body line is one upright-letter vertical strip. Increasing original columns run upward. Group spaces and indentation retain their physical columns. The red guide uses the final I as a hypothesis, not an established solution.
svg.metadata: Source SHA256 04eddf97e8ebbc9ce2565269508d63c99b60efc7cacf3f2c020f14215dc67e7e; diagram reflows rows horizontally, not a scan of the original pages.
svg.text: Transcript-derived diagram, not the page photographs. One original line per strip; spaces retain their columns.
Original columns increase upward; strips are displayed left-to-right in source row order. Zoom to read glyphs.
